video.title: “IT’S A SETUP”: Lowkey DROPS BOMBSHELL on Spain & Trump’s Extradition Deal
video.description:
Reporting for Double Down News, journalist and musician Lowkey examines the international legal battle surrounding American philanthropist and human rights advocate Fergie Chambers, who was granted conditional bail by Spain’s National Court in Madrid following U.S. extradition proceedings and an urgent asylum application.

Drawing on public court records and international legal commentary, Lowkey reviews:
• Chambers’ humanitarian relief funding and philanthropic initiatives
• Constitutional and First Amendment legal arguments surrounding a 2023 demonstration in New Hampshire
• Evidentiary and translation discrepancies acknowledged by U.S. officials, alongside property-transfer breaches under the 1970 U.S.–Spain Extradition Treaty
• Warnings from the UN Special Rapporteur on Human Rights Defenders ahead of a final ruling by Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez’s government

video.title: 'I'll never forget these scenes'- Tehran Fire Dept spox on rescuing civilians under US-Israeli bombs
video.description:
Jalal Maleki, the spokesman for the Tehran Fire Department, joins The Grayzone's Max Blumenthal to describe the harrowing scenes he witnessed during the war imposed on Iran this year by the US-Israeli coalition. Maleki recalls the shock of retrieving children from under the rubble of large residential buildings destroyed by the airstrikes, and details the US-Israeli pattern of targeting civilian neighborhoods with no regard for human life.

As one of the first one the scene after the US-Israeli bombing of the offices of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, Maleki provides exclusive detail on what he saw there, and how he discovered members of the leader's family. 

He also explains how US sanctions and the ongoing naval blockade have hampered his departments ability to save lives as it prepares for a possible third round of war in the near future.
